why: Q.5 'Complete the following Concept map' is printed as a diagram: a central 'World Heritage Sites' circle with four labelled boxes around it (Rock-cut Caves above, Natural Heritage left, Railway Station right, Sanctuary below), each carrying an outward dotted arrow to the blank the student fills.
